# GOV.UK Frontend

This directory contains the precompiled GOV.UK Frontend 6.4.0 release files.

Source: <https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-frontend/releases/tag/v6.4.0>

The release CSS uses root-relative `/assets/` URLs. These have been changed to
relative `assets/` URLs so fonts and images work when the static site is hosted
under the GitHub Pages project path.

`VERSION.txt` is retained from the official release archive.
